full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing a steady eighth-note pattern. A warm, legato cello enters to provide melodic counterpoint and low-end support. The vocal performance is intimate and breathy, utilizing a close-mic technique with subtle plate reverb. The tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The guitar uses a steel-string timbre with prominent string noise and fret slides. The cello performs long, sustained notes with moderate vibrato.
